# Reviewed copy of the Actions allow-list of this repository:
# Settings > Actions > General > "Allow ... specified actions and reusable
# workflows". GitHub does not read this file; the owner changes the setting
# by hand. When a workflow needs a new action, add the entry here in the
# same pull request, then update the setting.

# Also required on that page: "Allow actions created by GitHub"
# (actions/*, github/codeql-action).

# page, take the lines that do not start with `#`.
